links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM ensemble ground truth for periodic AI triage tool output assessment (MCC)
links.effect: Full-9 Ensemble MCC 0.571 (0.552-0.591), Top-3 0.558, Consensus 0.556, versus GPT-4o alone 0.522 (0.500-0.543); no significant differences among ensembles (p > 0.05).
links.quote: Using MCC (95% CI) the ideal combination of LLMs were: Full-9 Ensemble 0.571 (0.552-0.591), Top-3 Ensemble 0.558 (0.537-0.579), Consensus 0.556 (0.539-0.574), and GPT4o 0.522 (0.500-0.543).
